{{Quote|One of the Empire's top scientists during the war upgraded the fortress's defenses. He was the only non-Sith to ever see the inside.|Leeha Narezz|<ref name="Sub-Zero Showdown" />}}
During the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], a '''scientist''' was employed by the Empire to perform upgrades on the defense systems for the [[Emperor's Fortress|space fortress]] of the Empire's [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]]. The [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] was one of the Empire's finest and was the only non-[[Sith/Legends|Sith]] to ever set foot aboard the [[Space station/Legends|space station]], though he [[Death/Legends|died]] not long afterwards when his [[Pythar-class Imperial shuttlecraft|''Pythar''-class Imperial shuttlecraft]] ''[[Deference]]'' was shot down in the [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth system]] amidst the [[Battle of Hoth (Great Galactic War)|Battle of Hoth]]<ref name="Sub-Zero Showdown" /> in [[3665 BBY]].<ref name="Gnost" /> The scientist's [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] would crash in the [[Highmount Ridge]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], where it lay for over two decades until the [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] discovered the ship and removed its [[Memory bank/Legends|databank]]. Not long afterwards, the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Leeha Narezz]] and the [[Hero of Tython]] located the ''Deference'' in their [[Mission to Hoth (Hunt for the Sith Emperor)|search]] for the space station's plans.<ref name="Sub-Zero Showdown" />

==Behind the scenes==
The scientist was first mentioned in the [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', as the owner of the shuttle that players search for in the Jedi Knight mission "Sub-Zero Showdown" on Hoth.<ref name="Sub-Zero Showdown" />
